title: Chronica System Atlas Recovery Record
description: One entry in recovery-log.json -- the durable audit trail of every RECOVERY_REQUIRED task resolved via scripts/system-atlas/recovery.mjs's resolveRecovery(). Append-only; a resolved task_id may appear more than once across its lifetime (claim -> recover -> claim -> recover again is legal). Evidence is coordinator/operator-authored free text about control-plane state only (which lease/worker, what was observed, what cleanup happened) -- it must never carry secrets, credentials, or raw product-repo content.
